headlines.text: 10-year Treasury yield briefly tops 5% for the first time since 2023 as inflation and heavy debt supply spook bond markets.
Fed odds for a quarter-point hike at Wednesday's FOMC decision climb to roughly 92% as energy-driven inflation builds.
Chip stocks extend their slide as Amodei and Altman's AI-safety warnings reach beyond memory names, dropping Intel 7% and AMD 6%.
Brent crude spikes past $105 a barrel as Strait of Hormuz shipping attacks and a Saudi pipeline outage stoke supply fears.
Dollar posts its biggest jump since June as surging Treasury yields draw a flight to the greenback.
Asian stocks set to fall, tracking a Wall Street selloff driven by AI development jitters and rising yields.
